themes.title: Fear of making a work mistake with serious consequences
themes.interpretation: The student appears to be worried that a small mistake could have a very large consequence for their stay.

evidence.quote: I am scared to take it.
I heard if you work off campus you can lose your visa.
I keep thinking one wrong shift and I will be sent home.

themes.title: Unclear on what work is allowed
themes.interpretation: The student seems unsure what the work rules allow and has heard conflicting answers.

evidence.quote: I do not understand what is allowed and what is not

themes.title: Work-hour limits blocking a job offer
themes.interpretation: The student describes a limit on working hours that stands in the way of an offer they would otherwise take.

evidence.quote: I am not allowed to work this many hours, so I have to say no.

themes.title: Money is tight at the end of the month
themes.interpretation: The student may be facing real money pressure if the job offer does not work out.

evidence.quote: I will have to skip meals at the end of the month

recommendations.topic: Help the student get a clear answer on what work is allowed
recommendations.open_question: What have you heard so far, and from whom?
recommendations.suggested_approach: Write down the specific questions together and help them book a time with the right office to ask them.
based_on_titles: Unclear on what work is allowed
Work-hour limits blocking a job offer

recommendations.topic: Make room for the worry before problem-solving
recommendations.open_question: What goes through your mind when you think about starting the job?
recommendations.suggested_approach: Let them describe the worry in their own words, then look at the money question as a separate step.
based_on_titles: Fear of making a work mistake with serious consequences
Money is tight at the end of the month
